test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven boys I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII each have different ages. V is older than only II. I is younger than only VI. III is older than four other boys. VII is younger than IV. Who is the fourth eldest among the boys?
solution:
Seven boys I, II, III, IV, V, VI and VII each have different ages.

1. V is older than only II.

_ > _ > _ > _ > _ > V > II 

2. I is younger than only VI.

VI > I > _ > _ > _ > _ > _

3. III is older than four other boys.
